text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. However, for
some
reason...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're gonna play tag, Trainer! You
versus me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: And you're it first!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ding!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Starting... now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Our game of tag begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Think ya can catch me within the time
limit? If
you can, I've got some special
chocolate for you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: If you can't, you gotta eat beans.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure why I have to catch
her to get
chocolate or why I have to eat
beans if I don't.
Mysterious as the rules
are, we start the game.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Well, Тренер?! Do you give up?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oooh, you've got guts!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume certainly have incredible
stamina.
Tired and barely conscious, I
reach out my hand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! Just where do you think
you're
grabbing?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My fingertips catch Эль Кондор Паса's
mask and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...pull it off. Эль Кондор Паса's face is beet
red.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
D-don't look at me, please. Taking my
mask off is
against the rules...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
B-because... I'm... I'm embarrassed,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've never given anyone chocolate
before. I
thought it'd be more natural if
you just caught me
and took them.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So this was supposed to be natural... It
seems
challenging me to a game of tag
was her way of
hiding her
embarrassment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even though it was just the edge of my
mask, you
got me, so... You win.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So... here's your chocolate. I made it
myself.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
After getting such a sweet handmade
gift, I can't
help but open it and try
some right awa—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Тренер?! Are you okay? Are you alive?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I thought I might've put too much jalapeño in it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
These chocolates could be considered
the world's
strongest in their own way.
This is a truly
exhilarating Valentine's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer! Next is the Valentine's
date!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's go for a passionate night stroll in
the park!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not in a particularly passionate
mood, but a
walk might be good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you seen anything out of the
ordinary?
You never know if someone is
going to try to
sneak out on Valentine's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Catch anyone that tries to go out, all
right? We
can't let even one person get
by us.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: It's Vice President Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She's a tough one... like a viper! If she
catches
you, she doesn't let go! She just
squeezes and
squeezes!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Is this it for us?! Is this as far as we go?!
Should we
give up on our date?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Going out at night without permission is
strictly
forbidden, even when
accompanied by a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув is a tough cookie as well.
She's
unlikely to look the other way.
Unless...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why don't we try giving her you-know-what?

text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ohhh, you mean that!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув! Happy Valentine's Daaay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I brought some nice nutritious
chocolates for my
favorite overworked
vice president!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, Эль Кондор Паса. Don't mind if I
do...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Guh! Wh-what is this?! It's so spicy!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: You! Did you poison me?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Don't worryyy! The spiciness is addictive!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Now's our chance, Trainer. Let's flyyy!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Bueno! That was hella fun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Is your heart pounding too?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, getting out of a pinch like that
together
was kinda special...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I feel like we've really gotten closer. Isn't
this
called...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's called the suspension bridge effect.

Apparently, experiencing something
frightening
together can bring two
people closer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Right, the suspended ceiling effect!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If we do more exciting stuff, we'll get
hella close!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Would you... do a bunch of suspended
ceilings
with me today?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day evening and the
atmosphere
is unusually sweet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
These chocolates could be considered
the world's
strongest in their own way.
This is a truly
exhilarating Valentine's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mentally, Эль Кондор Паса's given me a
constant
string of suspended ceilings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
